p: Kirby removes hidden dirt deep within your carpets, where ordinary vacuums can't reach.
Moves with ease using automatic power assist and adjustable cleaning height.
Transforms from a vacuum into a shampooer, floor cleaner, and furniture cleaner.
The HEPA system captures 99.97% of particles down to 0.3 microns — dust, pollen, and pet allergens.
Made in the USA from cast aluminum, with a lifetime rebuilding program.
